suggested_fix: No fix required. The function takes a reference on the exec queue (xe_exec_queue_get) before storing it in the fence, so the queue cannot be freed while the fence is alive. It initializes the per-fence spinlock before handing it to dma_fence_init, and it safely removes the fence from any pre-allocation list with list_del_init. The caller is responsible for dropping the queue reference when the fence is signaled or released.
